name: Question 9
problem:
$$
{y}^{″}+4{\pi }^{2}y=f(x),\,y(0)=0,\,{y}^{′}(0)=0
$$

Consider the initial value problem above, where $f(x)$ is an odd, $6$-periodic function. Select the missing part in the solution of the IVP, where the second infinite sum on the right-hand side below represents a particular solution of the differential equation.

$$
y(x)∼{{field-1}}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\,\frac{36(-1)^{n}}{{n}^{2}{\pi }^{3}(36-{n}^{2})}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi x}{3})
$$
